title: NVMe-oF over RDMA: NVMe-over-Fabrics inherits RDMA's lack of authentication
impact: NVMe-over-Fabrics inherits RDMA's lack of authentication; storage targets are addressable by any host on the fabric, so a compromised tenant node can reach other tenants' namespaces. No CVE — design
remediation: Enforce NVMe-oF host NQN allowlisting plus DH-HMAC-CHAP authentication and separate storage fabric; costs throughput and adds provisioning complexity
